description: This file defines a React component called FilterableTable, which renders a filterable, sortable table with customizable columns and data. It includes internal functions for parsing numbers, sorting, and filtering table rows based on a search text.

methods.name: parseNumberFromString
methods.description: Parses a string or number to a float if it matches number formats, otherwise returns the original value.

methods.name: sortResults
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting values, handling numbers, nulls, and special numeric strings.
